{"local_delta": 0.0,
  "departures": [],
  "inherited_national_exposure": [
    "Executive order of 20 Jan 2025 redefining sex as a birth-determined binary, barring trans people from single-sex facilities congruent with identity, prohibiting self-selected gender on passports/visas.",
    "Foreign ministry stopped processing X-marker and non-birth-sex passport markers (Feb 2025); reports of passports confiscated/blocked and travellers stranded abroad; policy under national litigation.",
    "Feb 2025 visa screening: trans athletes banned, applicants listing a gender other than assigned sex flagged as fraud and permanently barred.",
    "Facilities-access restrictions: bathroom bans in state/provinces (students and some government buildings), outright bans in additional units, criminal exposure in some; Apr 2025 bathroom-law arrest.",
    "Feb 2026 unit law invalidating birth certificates/driver's licences not matching sex assigned at birth and barring trans people from sex-segregated facilities; pending targeting bills.",
    "Custody/detention: national corrections bureau adoption of conversion-therapy-style policies from 2026; immigration-custody forced labour, beatings, solitary confinement and sexual abuse reported.",
    "Official hostility to advocacy: Dec 2025 cash-bounty instruction targeting trans activists; May 2026 counterterrorism strategy framing 'radically pro-transgender' ideology as a security threat.",
    "Partial protection machinery: national gender-identity hate-crime coverage and 22 state/provinces plus capital district anti-discrimination law, but only 23 state/provinces with gender-identity bias-crime statutes.",
    "Travel advisories from at least eight allied governments (Mar–Apr 2025) over identity-document, data and visa-detention issues.",
    "No trans-specific violence or homicide rate in the record (no comparison to background homicide possible); airport-screening data limited to generic advocacy guidance."
  ],
  "uncertainty": "The local bundle for this division is entirely empty: no statutes, enforcement records, facilities rules, custody practices, police conduct, violence data or social-attitude evidence specific to the division. With no documented local departure in either direction, the delta cannot be resolved from evidence; a zero delta here is a diagnostic of missing local data, not proof that the division matches the national level in practice. The national dossier itself notes unit-level variation is uneven and moving, so a division-specific difference is plausible but undocumented.",
  "notes": "Assessed only the signed local difference against the frozen national level 0.330; no national factor was re-rated and no shadow or national score is produced. Because no local evidence exists, no departure can be cited, no fact can be shown to be locally distinct from the inherited national exposure, and no item can be counted in the delta. Per the rubric, thin or absent evidence yields a small or zero delta rather than an invented departure; therefore local_delta = 0.0, with the inherited national exposures (passport/marker friction, visa flagging, facility-access restrictions, unit-level document and bathroom laws, custody and detention harms, activist-targeting rhetoric, partial protection machinery) left inside the fixed national level and deliberately not re-counted."
}
